title: Bollywood Actor Ashwin Mushran Accused of Hitting Father-Son Duo in Goa
excerpt: The Lage Raho Munna Bhai actor allegedly struck a two-wheeler while driving on the wrong side of the road in Quepem, with a video of him arguing with locals going viral on social media.
body:
• Actor Ashwin Mushran has been accused of hitting a father-son duo riding a two-wheeler in Goa's Quepem area while allegedly driving on the wrong side of the road.
  • A video showing Mushran arguing with local residents after the incident has gone viral across social media platforms.
  • The actor, best known for his role in Lage Raho Munna Bhai, has reportedly refused to apologise to the victims.
  • Local residents confronted the actor at the scene, and the incident has drawn widespread criticism online.

What Happened in Quepem

Bollywood actor Ashwin Mushran, known for his roles in Lage Raho Munna Bhai and other Hindi films, has found himself at the centre of a controversy after being accused of hitting a father-son duo riding a two-wheeler in Goa's Quepem area.

https://x.com/CNNnews18/status/2088913114658230623

According to multiple reports from Hindustan Times, Mid-Day, and local Goa media outlets, the incident occurred when Mushran was allegedly driving his car on the wrong side of the road. The car collided with a two-wheeler carrying a father and his son, injuring both.

Viral Video Sparks Outrage

A video capturing the aftermath of the incident has surfaced on social media, showing the actor in a heated argument with local residents who had gathered at the scene. In the footage, Mushran can be seen confronting the locals rather than showing concern for the injured duo.

According to Prudent Media Goa, residents of the area confronted the actor after the crash, accusing him of reckless driving. The video shows the exchange growing increasingly tense as locals demanded accountability.

"He was driving on the wrong side and hit them, and then he started arguing with people instead of helping."

— Local resident, as reported by Prudent Media Goa

Actor's Response

Reports indicate that Mushran has refused to apologise for the incident, further fuelling public anger. The Times of India reported that despite being accused of causing the accident, the actor was seen arguing with bystanders rather than attending to the injured victims.

Mushran, who has appeared in several Bollywood films and is also known for his voice acting work, has not issued a formal public statement on the incident as of the time of reporting.

Growing Concern Over Road Safety in Goa

The incident comes amid rising concerns about road safety in Goa, a state that has seen numerous accidents linked to reckless driving, particularly by tourists and visitors. Local authorities have been under pressure to enforce stricter traffic regulations in the coastal state.

Goa has consistently ranked among Indian states with high road accident fatality rates relative to its population, with wrong-side driving being a frequent contributing factor in collisions.

What's Next

It remains unclear whether a formal police complaint has been filed by the victims. Social media users have called for legal action against the actor, with the viral video continuing to circulate across platforms. The incident is likely to add to the broader conversation about celebrity accountability and road safety enforcement in tourist-heavy regions like Goa.
